# Avet's Estate

> A MERN-stack real estate web app for browsing, searching, and comparing property listings for rent and sale across 10 countries, with favorites, image galleries, a mortgage calculator, and direct seller contact.

## Pages

- [Home](https://avets-real-estate.vercel.app/): Featured offers, recent rentals and sales.
- [Search](https://avets-real-estate.vercel.app/search): Filter listings by keyword, type, country, city, amenities, and price.
- [Sign in](https://avets-real-estate.vercel.app/sign-in): Email/password or Google authentication.
- [Sign up](https://avets-real-estate.vercel.app/sign-up): Create an account.

## Notes

- Single-page React application (Vite).
- Listing data is served from a REST API under /api/listing.
